schema_documentation:
One key-set of exactly 3 top-level keys for all 3,889 records (stats json).
- `success` — bool, 100%. Always `True`. API wrapper flag, no information.
- `text` — str, 100%, nonempty 100%. Pre-flattened `title.el` + description + remarks + application_description. 95–14,661 chars, mean 762.9, sum_len 2,966,865.
- `data` — dict, 100%. Sub-keys: `data.id` (str, 6 chars), `data.uuid` (str, 36), `data.url` (str, 30), `data.ns` (str, always "ΔΔ"), `data.last_updated` (str, ISO-8601, 25), `data.title` (dict: `.el` str 100% / `.en` str 14.4%), `data.metadata` (dict).
- `data.metadata` sub-keys: `process` (dict, 100%; **98 distinct sub-keys across the corpus**, only 3 present in all 3,889 records, per-record key count ~20–45 with mode 31), `glance` (dict, 100%), `process_rules` (list, 99.61%, mean 4.1 items), `process_steps` (list, 95.32%, mean 8.2), `process_conditions` (list, 90.61%, mean 3.8), `process_evidences` (list, 77.86%, mean 5.9), `process_useful_links` (list, 47.16%), `process_provision_digital_locations` (list, 34.1%), `process_evidences_cost` (list, 28.49%), `process_steps_digital` (list, 6.48%).
- Text-bearing `process` fields (measured by render_mitos.py): `remarks` 1,367,604 chars, `description` 1,265,200, `application_note` 844,971, `sdg_notes` 679,645, `application_description` 347,481, `official_title` 319,585.
semantic_meaning: 3,889 Greek public-administration procedures from the MITOS registry (gov.gr) as raw API responses: a thin flat `text` plus the full deeply-nested procedure record.
split_group_rule: Hash originating source identity; dictionary group by normalized lemma; recipes by normalized recipe title conservatively across ingredient variants; sentiment by complete normalized review content. Global duplicate components must share a split.
